notes.title: The sequel to the game Little Kite
notes.notes:
I'm glad to announce that the development of the sequel to the game Little Kite  has begun.
This time the main character is Oliver. Yes, he's alive. The story take place seven years after the events in Little Kite.

Stay tuned for news of developing progress on 
[url=https://www.facebook.com/anatestudio/?ref=bookmarks]  facebook	[/url]
and  
[url=https://twitter.com/anatestudio]  twitter.	[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30583728/1fb07be77f5a35893f82d32267252d9857ab8344.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Little Kite Original Soundtrack is available now!
notes.notes:
Check out dramatic and tense ambient Soundtrack for the game Little Kite created by Abstracode.

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30583728/c2ab802d69a7fa33337f9de6f06da2f6f1c35c53.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30583728/c78d5fd1facaa36f5202bc8f186097a71a4f041b.jpg[/img][/url]

Little Kite OST - Track list:

01 Little Kite
02 Home
03 Hug your Mom
